title_sq: Super apartament gati per banim te rezidenca Kadiu!
description_sq:
Shitet apartament 1+1, siperfaqe 59.8 m2, kati 4, gati per banim te kompleksi Mangalem, faza Kadiu. Apartamenti ka nje planimetri te regullt e te mireshfrytezuar. 
Pagese me keste e mundesi kreditimi 80%. 
Apartamenti dorezohet me dyer, dritare, grila, laminat dhe tualet i kompletuar me hidrosanitare inkaso.
title_en: Super apartment ready for living in Kadiu residence!
description_en: 1+1 apartment for sale, surface area 59.8 m2, 4th floor, ready for living in the Mangalem complex, Kadiu phase. The apartment has a regular and well-used layout. Payment in installments and 80% credit possibility. The apartment is delivered with doors, windows, shutters, laminate and a toilet complete with a flush toilet.
